## 7. Nested object runner (`kind: object`)

Every `x3_object` / `x3_object_write` call lands here. **Validate** checks the action (describe, list, read, create, modify), the object code, the identifier and the payload before anything reaches Sage X3, and refuses create and modify unless `allow_write` is true: `x3_object` never writes, only `x3_object_write` does. **Route** sends each action to its own Sage X3 node; **Shape** returns `{ ok, action, object, identifier, data, messages }` or `{ ok: false, error, message }`.

Replace `YOUR_X3_USER` on the Create node by the X3 user the records must be created under.

One row per item x site.","returns":"SITE, ITEM, DESCRIPTION, STOCK_UNIT, CATEGORY_LABEL, ITEM_STATUS_LABEL, STOCK_MANAGEMENT_LABEL, STOCK_ACCEPTED_A, STOCK_QUALITY_Q, STOCK_REJECTED_R, STOCK_TOTAL, ALLOCATED_DETAILED, ALLOCATED_GLOBAL, SHORTAGE_GLOBAL, EXPECTED_SALES_ORDERS, EXPECTED_REPLENISHMENT, IN_TRANSIT, PENDING_ISSUES, STOCK_AVAILABLE, REORDER_POINT, SAFETY_STOCK, STOCK_MAX, BELOW_REORDER_POINT, AVERAGE_COST, STOCK_VALUE_A, LAST_RECEIPT, LAST_ISSUE, LAST_COUNT.","notes":"The figure to quote is STOCK_AVAILABLE (accepted stock minus detailed and global allocations), never STOCK_TOTAL.","max_rows":400,"max_time":30,"sql":"/* Available stock by item and site (ITMMVT totals + ITMFACILIT replenishment parameters). */

    ISNULL(ITV.PHYALL_0, 0)  AS ALLOCATED_DETAILED,

Sorted by descending movement date.","notes":"Always bound date_from and date_to.","max_rows":400,"max_time":30,"sql":"/* Stock movements, line by line (STOJOU journal). Quantities are signed. */

Sorted by descending order date.","notes":"Always bound date_from and date_to.","max_rows":2000,"max_time":20,"sql":"/* Sales order lines (SORDER + SORDERP + SORDERQ): ordered quantities, the history. */

Always bound date_from and date_to.","max_rows":1000,"max_time":60,"sql":"/* Revenue aggregated on the database side, converted to EUR, billed and ordered horizons.
   The level filter picks the GROUPING SETS row family to return. */
SELECT
    AGG.LEVEL               AS LEVEL,
    AGG.REVENUE_TYPE        AS REVENUE_TYPE,
    AGG.YEAR                AS YEAR,
    AGG.MONTH               AS MONTH,
    AGG.CUSTOMER_CODE       AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
    AGG.CUSTOMER_NAME       AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    AGG.ITEM                AS ITEM,
    AGG.DESCRIPTION         AS DESCRIPTION,
    AGG.DOCUMENT_COUNT      AS DOCUMENT_COUNT,
    AGG.LINE_COUNT          AS LINE_COUNT,
    AGG.LINES_WITHOUT_RATE  AS LINES_WITHOUT_RATE,
    AGG.QUANTITY            AS QUANTITY,
    AGG.REVENUE_EUR         AS REVENUE_EUR
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.YEAR) = 0                                     THEN 'Month'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.CUSTOMER_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CA.ITEM) = 0  THEN 'CustomerItem'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.CUSTOMER_CODE) = 0                            THEN 'Customer'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.ITEM) = 0                                     THEN 'Item'
            ELSE 'Total'
        END                                                         AS LEVEL,
        CA.REVENUE_TYPE,
        CA.YEAR,
        CA.MONTH,
        CA.CUSTOMER_CODE,
        CASE WHEN GROUPING(CA.CUSTOMER_CODE) = 0 THEN MAX(CA.CUSTOMER_NAME) END AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
        CA.ITEM,
        CASE WHEN GROUPING(CA.ITEM) = 0 THEN MAX(CA.DESCRIPTION) END AS DESCRIPTION,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CA.DOCUMENT)                             AS DOCUMENT_COUNT,
        COUNT(*)                                                AS LINE_COUNT,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CA.AMOUNT_EUR IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS LINES_WITHOUT_RATE,
        SUM(CA.QUANTITY)                                        AS QUANTITY,
        SUM(CA.AMOUNT_EUR)                                      AS REVENUE_EUR
    FROM (

    /* ---------- Billed ---------- */
    SELECT
        'Billed' AS REVENUE_TYPE,
        SID.NUM_0     AS DOCUMENT,
        SID.SIDLIN_0  AS LINE,
        YEAR(SIE.ACCDAT_0)                 AS YEAR,
        MONTH(SIE.ACCDAT_0)                AS MONTH,
        SID.BPCINV_0                       AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
        BPR.BPRNAM_0                       AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
        SID.ITMREF_0                       AS ITEM,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0) AS DESCRIPTION,
        ITM.TCLCOD_0                       AS X3_CATEGORY,
        SID.SALFCY_0                       AS SITE,
        (CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 1) WHEN 2 THEN -1 WHEN 4 THEN -1 WHEN 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SID.QTY_0 AS QUANTITY,
        SIE.CUR_0                          AS CURRENCY,
        (CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 1) WHEN 2 THEN -1 WHEN 4 THEN -1 WHEN 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SID.AMTNOTLIN_0
        * CASE WHEN SIE.CUR_0 = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(
            (SELECT TOP (1) TCH.CHGRAT_0
               FROM TABCHANGE TCH
              WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = SIE.CUR_0 AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
                AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SIE.ACCDAT_0
              ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC),
            (SELECT TOP (1) 1.0 / NULLIF(TCH.CHGRAT_0, 0)
               FROM TABCHANGE TCH
              WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = SIE.CUR_0 AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
                AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SIE.ACCDAT_0
              ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC)
        ) END                              AS AMOUNT_EUR
    FROM SINVOICED SID
    JOIN SINVOICE  SIE ON SIE.NUM_0 = SID.NUM_0
    LEFT JOIN TABSIVTYP TIV ON TIV.SIVTYP_0 = SIE.SIVTYP_0
    LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = SID.ITMREF_0
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
        FROM   ATEXTRA WHERE CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES1AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = {{lang}}
        GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
    ) DES1 ON DES1.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)
    LEFT JOIN BPARTNER BPR ON BPR.BPRNUM_0 = SID.BPCINV_0
    WHERE 1 = 1
    /*FILTERS:billed*/

    UNION ALL

    /* ---------- Ordered, not yet invoiced ---------- */
    SELECT
        'Ordered',
        SOQ.SOHNUM_0,
        SOQ.SOPLIN_0,
        YEAR(SOQ.SHIDAT_0),
        MONTH(SOQ.SHIDAT_0),
        SOQ.BPCORD_0,
        BPC.BPCNAM_0,
        SOQ.ITMREF_0,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0),
        ITM.TCLCOD_0,
        SOQ.STOFCY_0,
        (SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)),
        SOH.CUR_0,
        (SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)) * SOP.NETPRI_0
        * CASE WHEN SOH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(
            (SELECT TOP (1) TCH.CHGRAT_0
               FROM TABCHANGE TCH
              WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = SOH.CUR_0 AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
                AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SOH.ORDDAT_0
              ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC),
            (SELECT TOP (1) 1.0 / NULLIF(TCH.CHGRAT_0, 0)
               FROM TABCHANGE TCH
              WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = SOH.CUR_0 AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
                AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SOH.ORDDAT_0
              ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC)
        ) END
    FROM SORDERQ SOQ
    JOIN SORDERP SOP ON SOP.SOHNUM_0 = SOQ.SOHNUM_0 AND SOP.SOPLIN_0 = SOQ.SOPLIN_0
    LEFT JOIN SORDER SOH     ON SOH.SOHNUM_0 = SOQ.SOHNUM_0

    LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER  ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = SOQ.ITMREF_0

    WHERE SOQ.SOQSTA_0 < 3   -- open lines only

    ) CA

    /*FILTERS*/
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (CA.REVENUE_TYPE),
        (CA.REVENUE_TYPE, CA.YEAR, CA.MONTH),
        (CA.REVENUE_TYPE, CA.CUSTOMER_CODE),
        (CA.REVENUE_TYPE, CA.ITEM),
        (CA.REVENUE_TYPE, CA.CUSTOMER_CODE, CA.ITEM)

) AGG

    NULLIF(SIE.ACCDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS REF_DATE,
    YEAR(SIE.ACCDAT_0)  AS YEAR,
    MONTH(SIE.ACCDAT_0) AS MONTH,
    SID.BPCINV_0  AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
    BPR.BPRNAM_0  AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    SID.REP1_0    AS SALES_REP,
    SID.ITMREF_0        AS ITEM,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0) AS DESCRIPTION,
    ITM.TCLCOD_0        AS X3_CATEGORY,
    ISNULL(CAT.LABEL, ITM.TCLCOD_0) AS X3_CATEGORY_LABEL,
    ISNULL(AD_TS0.TEXTE_0, 'Not set') AS STAT_GROUP1,
    SID.SALFCY_0  AS SITE,
    SID.STOFCY_0  AS SHIPMENT_SITE,
    (CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 1) WHEN 2 THEN -1 WHEN 4 THEN -1 WHEN 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SID.QTY_0 AS QUANTITY,
    SID.STU_0           AS UNIT,
    SIE.CUR_0           AS CURRENCY,
    (CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 1) WHEN 2 THEN -1 WHEN 4 THEN -1 WHEN 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SID.AMTNOTLIN_0 AS AMOUNT_CURRENCY,
    CASE WHEN SIE.CUR_0 = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(
        (SELECT TOP (1) TCH.CHGRAT_0
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = SIE.CUR_0 AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SIE.ACCDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC),
        (SELECT TOP (1) 1.0 / NULLIF(TCH.CHGRAT_0, 0)
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = SIE.CUR_0 AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SIE.ACCDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC)
    ) END           AS EUR_RATE,
    (CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 1) WHEN 2 THEN -1 WHEN 4 THEN -1 WHEN 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SID.AMTNOTLIN_0
    * CASE WHEN SIE.CUR_0 = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(
        (SELECT TOP (1) TCH.CHGRAT_0

          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = SIE.CUR_0 AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SIE.ACCDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC),
        (SELECT TOP (1) 1.0 / NULLIF(TCH.CHGRAT_0, 0)
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = SIE.CUR_0 AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SIE.ACCDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC)
    ) END           AS AMOUNT_EUR,
    SIE.SIVTYP_0        AS STATUS_CODE,
    CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 0)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Invoice (1)'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Credit memo (2)'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Debit note (3)'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Credit note (4)'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Proforma (5)'
        ELSE 'Not specified (' + RTRIM(ISNULL(SIE.SIVTYP_0, '')) + ')'
    END                 AS STATUS_LABEL
FROM SINVOICED SID
JOIN SINVOICE  SIE ON SIE.NUM_0 = SID.NUM_0
LEFT JOIN TABSIVTYP TIV ON TIV.SIVTYP_0 = SIE.SIVTYP_0
LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = SID.ITMREF_0

    FROM   ATEXTRA WHERE CODFIC_0 = 'ITMCATEG' AND ZONE_0 = 'TCLAXX' AND LANGUE_0 = {{lang}}

Always bound date_from and date_to.","max_rows":1000,"max_time":30,"sql":"/* Order book: ordered and not yet invoiced, line by line (SORDERQ + SORDERP + SORDER). */
SELECT
    'Ordered'     AS REVENUE_TYPE,
    SOQ.SOHNUM_0  AS DOCUMENT,
    SOQ.SOPLIN_0  AS LINE,
    NULLIF(SOQ.SHIDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS REF_DATE,
    YEAR(SOQ.SHIDAT_0)  AS YEAR,
    MONTH(SOQ.SHIDAT_0) AS MONTH,
    SOQ.BPCORD_0  AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
    BPC.BPCNAM_0  AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    SOP.REP1_0    AS SALES_REP,
    SOQ.ITMREF_0        AS ITEM,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0) AS DESCRIPTION,
    ITM.TCLCOD_0        AS X3_CATEGORY,
    ISNULL(CAT.LABEL, ITM.TCLCOD_0) AS X3_CATEGORY_LABEL,
    ISNULL(AD_TS0.TEXTE_0, 'Not set') AS STAT_GROUP1,
    SOQ.STOFCY_0        AS SITE,
    (SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)) AS QUANTITY,
    SOP.STU_0           AS UNIT,
    SOH.CUR_0           AS CURRENCY,
    (SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)) * SOP.NETPRI_0 AS AMOUNT_CURRENCY,
    CASE WHEN SOH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(
        (SELECT TOP (1) TCH.CHGRAT_0
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = SOH.CUR_0 AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SOH.ORDDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC),
        (SELECT TOP (1) 1.0 / NULLIF(TCH.CHGRAT_0, 0)
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = SOH.CUR_0 AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SOH.ORDDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC)
    ) END           AS EUR_RATE,
    (SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)) * SOP.NETPRI_0
    * CASE WHEN SOH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(
        (SELECT TOP (1) TCH.CHGRAT_0
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = SOH.CUR_0 AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SOH.ORDDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC),
        (SELECT TOP (1) 1.0 / NULLIF(TCH.CHGRAT_0, 0)
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = SOH.CUR_0 AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SOH.ORDDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC)
    ) END           AS AMOUNT_EUR,
    SOQ.SOQSTA_0        AS STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_SOQ.LANMES_0, 'Unknown') + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(SOQ.SOQSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')' AS STATUS_LABEL,
    SOH.ORDSTA_0        AS ORDER_STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_ORD.LANMES_0, 'Unknown') + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(SOH.ORDSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')' AS ORDER_STATUS_LABEL,
    SOQ.SOHCAT_0        AS ORDER_CATEGORY_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_CAT.LANMES_0, 'Unknown') + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(SOQ.SOHCAT_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')' AS ORDER_CATEGORY_LABEL,
    SOQ.INVFLG_0        AS INVOICED_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_INV.LANMES_0, 'Unknown') + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(SOQ.INVFLG_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')' AS INVOICED_LABEL,
    SOQ.QTY_0     AS ORDERED_QTY,
    SOQ.DLVQTY_0  AS DELIVERED_QTY,
    SOQ.INVQTY_0  AS INVOICED_QTY,
    SOQ.ALLQTY_0  AS ALLOCATED_QTY,
    SOQ.SHTQTY_0  AS SHORTAGE_QTY,
    SOP.NETPRI_0  AS NET_PRICE
FROM SORDERQ SOQ
JOIN SORDERP SOP ON SOP.SOHNUM_0 = SOQ.SOHNUM_0 AND SOP.SOPLIN_0 = SOQ.SOPLIN_0
LEFT JOIN SORDER SOH     ON SOH.SOHNUM_0 = SOQ.SOHNUM_0
LEFT JOIN BPCUSTOMER BPC ON BPC.BPCNUM_0 = SOQ.BPCORD_0
LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER  ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = SOQ.ITMREF_0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA WHERE CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES1AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = {{lang}}
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES1 ON DES1.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0) AS TCLCOD, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA WHERE CODFIC_0 = 'ITMCATEG' AND ZONE_0 = 'TCLAXX' AND LANGUE_0 = {{lang}}
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0)
) CAT ON CAT.TCLCOD = RTRIM(ITM.TCLCOD_0)
LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA AD_TS0 ON AD_TS0.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' AND AD_TS0.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES' AND AD_TS0.LANGUE_0 = {{lang}} AND AD_TS0.IDENT1_0 = '20' AND AD_TS0.IDENT2_0 = ITM.TSICOD_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_SOQ ON ML_SOQ.LAN_0 = {{lang}} AND ML_SOQ.LANCHP_0 = 279 AND ML_SOQ.LANNUM_0 = SOQ.SOQSTA_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_ORD ON ML_ORD.LAN_0 = {{lang}} AND ML_ORD.LANCHP_0 = 415 AND ML_ORD.LANNUM_0 = SOH.ORDSTA_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_CAT ON ML_CAT.LAN_0 = {{lang}} AND ML_CAT.LANCHP_0 = 412 AND ML_CAT.LANNUM_0 = SOQ.SOHCAT_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_INV ON ML_INV.LAN_0 = {{lang}} AND ML_INV.LANCHP_0 = 1   AND ML_INV.LANNUM_0 = SOQ.INVFLG_0
WHERE 1 = 1
/*FILTERS*/

ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)) > 0"},{"name":"date_from","type":"date","required":false,"description":"Minimum planned shipment date, included, YYYY-MM-DD.","clause":"AND SOQ.SHIDAT_0 >= {{date_from}}"},{"name":"date_to","type":"date","required":false,"description":"Maximum planned shipment date, included, YYYY-MM-DD.","clause":"AND SOQ.SHIDAT_0 <= {{date_to}}"}]},{"name":"x3_supplier_item_code","group":"purchasing","purpose":"Translate between the Sage X3 item reference and a supplier's own reference (ITMBPS): the code to quote on a purchase order, reconcile a supplier acknowledgement or catalogue, list what a supplier references.","returns":"One row per item x supplier: SUPPLIER_CODE, SUPPLIER_NAME, ITEM, X3_DESCRIPTION, SUPPLIER_ITEM_REF, SUPPLIER_DESCRIPTION (often empty), PRIORITY, MINIMUM_PO_QTY (in purchase unit), PURCHASE_UNIT.","notes":"PRIORITY ranks the suppliers of one item: the lower the value, the higher the priority. 0 means not filled in, never top priority. Reference data only: it says nothing about what was ordered or received.","max_rows":300,"max_time":20,"sql":"/* Item x supplier cross-reference (ITMBPS): the supplier's own item reference, priority and minimum order quantity. */
SELECT
    ITS.BPSNUM_0    AS SUPPLIER_CODE,
    BPS.BPSNAM_0    AS SUPPLIER_NAME,
    ITS.ITMREF_0    AS ITEM,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0) AS X3_DESCRIPTION,
    ITS.ITMREFBPS_0 AS SUPPLIER_ITEM_REF,
    ITS.ITMDESBPS_0 AS SUPPLIER_DESCRIPTION,
    ITS.PIO_0       AS PRIORITY,
    ITS.PURMINQTY_0 AS MINIMUM_PO_QTY,
    ITM.PUU_0       AS PURCHASE_UNIT
FROM ITMBPS ITS
LEFT JOIN BPSUPPLIER BPS ON BPS.BPSNUM_0 = ITS.BPSNUM_0

LEFT JOIN (

    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES1 ON DES1.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)
WHERE 1 = 1

ORDER BY ITS.ITMREF_0, ITS.PIO_0, ITS.BPSNUM_0","filters":[{"name":"supplier_code","type":"list","required":false,"description":"One or more exact supplier codes (BPSNUM_0), e.g. FR063.","clause":"AND ITS.BPSNUM_0 IN ({{supplier_code}})"},{"name":"item","type":"list","required":false,"description":"One or more Sage X3 item references (ITMREF_0).","clause":"AND ITS.ITMREF_0 IN ({{item}})"},{"name":"supplier_item_ref","type":"list","required":false,"description":"The supplier's own item references (ITMREFBPS_0), exact.","clause":"AND ITS.ITMREFBPS_0 IN ({{supplier_item_ref}})"},{"name":"supplier_item_ref_contains","type":"contains","required":false,"description":"Fragment of the supplier's item reference.","clause":"AND UPPER(ITS.ITMREFBPS_0) LIKE UPPER({{supplier_item_ref_contains}})"},{"name":"supplier_name","type":"contains","required":false,"description":"Fragment of the supplier name.","clause":"AND UPPER(BPS.BPSNAM_0) LIKE UPPER({{supplier_name}})"}]},{"name":"x3_component_impact_chain","group":"purchasing","purpose":"Answer what breaks if this purchased component arrives late: the open work orders consuming it (MFGMAT + MFGHEAD), the finished item they produce (MFGITM) and the open sales order lines pulling that finished item. One row per component x work order x sales order line, the whole chain in one call.","returns":"COMPONENT, WORK_ORDER, WO_STATUS_LABEL, WO_SITE, COMPONENT_NEED_DATE, WO_START_DATE, WO_END_DATE, COMPONENT_QTY_STILL_NEEDED, COMPONENT_STOCK_SITE, COMPONENT_STOCK_AVAILABLE, FINISHED_ITEM, WO_PLANNED_QTY, WO_REMAINING_QTY, FINISHED_STOCK_SITE, FINISHED_STOCK_AVAILABLE, SALES_ORDER, SO_LINE_STATUS_LABEL, CUSTOMER_CODE, CUSTOMER_NAME, SO_CREATED_BY, SO_CREATED_BY_NAME, SO_CREATED_BY_EMAIL, SO_ORDERED_QTY, SO_DELIVERED_QTY, SO_QTY_TO_DELIVER, SO_REQUESTED_DELIVERY_DATE.","notes":"COMPONENT_NEED_DATE is the date to compare a new expected receipt date against. COMPONENT_QTY_STILL_NEEDED is net of what is already consumed. WO_REMAINING_QTY = 0 with a non-zero component need is normal: the finished item is declared but the consumption is not yet recorded. Only firm and in-progress work orders (status 1, 2) are listed.","max_rows":1000,"max_time":30,"sql":"/* Downstream impact of a purchased component: open work orders consuming it (MFGMAT + MFGHEAD),
   the finished item they produce (MFGITM) and the open sales order lines pulling that finished item. */
SELECT
    MFM.ITMREF_0                        AS COMPONENT,
    MFM.MFGNUM_0                        AS WORK_ORDER,
    MFG.MFGSTA_0                        AS WO_STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_MST.LANMES_0, 'Unknown') + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(MFG.MFGSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')' AS WO_STATUS_LABEL,
    MFM.MFGFCY_0                        AS WO_SITE,
    NULLIF(MFM.RETDAT_0, '1753-01-01')  AS COMPONENT_NEED_DATE,
    NULLIF(MFG.STRDAT_0, '1753-01-01')  AS WO_START_DATE,
    NULLIF(MFG.ENDDAT_0, '1753-01-01')  AS WO_END_DATE,
    MFM.RETQTY_0 - MFM.USEQTY_0         AS COMPONENT_QTY_STILL_NEEDED,
    ITVC.STOFCY_0                       AS COMPONENT_STOCK_SITE,
    ISNULL(ITVC.PHYSTO_0, 0) - ISNULL(ITVC.PHYALL_0, 0) - ISNULL(ITVC.GLOALL_0, 0) AS COMPONENT_STOCK_AVAILABLE,
    MFI.ITMREF_0                        AS FINISHED_ITEM,
    MFI.EXTQTY_0                        AS WO_PLANNED_QTY,
    MFI.RMNEXTQTY_0                     AS WO_REMAINING_QTY,
    ITVP.STOFCY_0                       AS FINISHED_STOCK_SITE,
    ISNULL(ITVP.PHYSTO_0, 0) - ISNULL(ITVP.PHYALL_0, 0) - ISNULL(ITVP.GLOALL_0, 0) AS FINISHED_STOCK_AVAILABLE,
    SOQ.SOHNUM_0                        AS SALES_ORDER,
    SOQ.SOQSTA_0                        AS SO_LINE_STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_SST.LANMES_0, 'Unknown') + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(SOQ.SOQSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')' AS SO_LINE_STATUS_LABEL,
    SOH.BPCORD_0                        AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
    SOH.BPCNAM_0                        AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    SOH.CREUSR_0                        AS SO_CREATED_BY,
    ISNULL(AUS.NOMUSR_0, '')            AS SO_CREATED_BY_NAME,
    ISNULL(AUS.ADDEML_0, '')            AS SO_CREATED_BY_EMAIL,
    SOQ.QTY_0                           AS SO_ORDERED_QTY,
    SOQ.DLVQTY_0                        AS SO_DELIVERED_QTY,
    SOQ.QTY_0 - SOQ.DLVQTY_0            AS SO_QTY_TO_DELIVER,
    NULLIF(SOQ.DEMDLVDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS SO_REQUESTED_DELIVERY_DATE
FROM MFGMAT MFM
INNER JOIN MFGHEAD MFG ON MFG.MFGNUM_0 = MFM.MFGNUM_0
INNER JOIN MFGITM  MFI ON MFI.MFGNUM_0 = MFM.MFGNUM_0
LEFT JOIN ITMMVT ITVC ON ITVC.ITMREF_0 = MFM.ITMREF_0 AND ITVC.STOFCY_0 = MFM.MFGFCY_0
LEFT JOIN ITMMVT ITVP ON ITVP.ITMREF_0 = MFI.ITMREF_0 AND ITVP.STOFCY_0 = MFI.MFGFCY_0
LEFT JOIN SORDERQ SOQ ON SOQ.ITMREF_0 = MFI.ITMREF_0 AND SOQ.SOQSTA_0 = 1

// Code node "Validate the object call" of the X3 Object Runner (run once for all items).
// Input: { action, object, transaction, identifier, data, allow_write }.
// Output: { ok, action, object, transaction, identifier, data } or { ok: false, error, message }.

const READ_ACTIONS = ['describe', 'list', 'read'];
const WRITE_ACTIONS = ['create', 'modify'];

function error(code, message, extra) {
  return Object.assign({ ok: false, error: code, message }, extra || {});
}

function parseData(raw) {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined || raw === '') return {};
  if (typeof raw === 'string') {
    const text = raw.trim();
    if (text === '' || text === 'null') return {};
    try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { return { __invalid: 'data is not valid JSON: ' + text.slice(0, 120) }; }
  }
  if (typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) return { __invalid: 'data must be a JSON object keyed by screen block' };
  return raw;
}

function validate(input) {
  const action = String(input.action || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const allowWrite = input.allow_write === true || String(input.allow_write).toLowerCase() === 'true';
  if (!READ_ACTIONS.includes(action) && !WRITE_ACTIONS.includes(action)) {
    return error('unknown_action', `action must be one of ${[...READ_ACTIONS, ...WRITE_ACTIONS].join(', ')}, got "${input.action}"`);
  }
  if (WRITE_ACTIONS.includes(action) && !allowWrite) {
    return error('write_not_allowed', `${action} is a write action: call x3_object_write, after the user confirmed the change.`);
  }
  const object = String(input.object || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,11}$/.test(object)) {
    return error('invalid_object', `object must be a Sage X3 object code such as SOH, ITM or BPC, got "${input.object}". Find it with x3_query_run on x3_object_search.`);
  }
  const transaction = String(input.transaction || '').trim();
  const identifier = String(input.identifier || '').trim();
  const data = parseData(input.data);
  if (data.__invalid) return error('invalid_data', data.__invalid);
  if ((action === 'read' || action === 'modify') && !identifier) {
    return error('missing_identifier', `${action} needs the exact identifier of the record (composite keys joined with ~). Get it from a list or a SQL query.`);
  }
  if ((action === 'create' || action === 'modify') && Object.keys(data).length === 0) {
    return error('missing_data', `${action} needs a data payload keyed by screen block, with field names from describe.`);
  }
  return { ok: true, action, object, transaction, identifier, data };
}

function main() {
  const first = $input.first();
  return [{ json: validate(first ? first.json : {}) }];
}

return main();

One row per item x site.","returns":"SITE, ITEM, DESCRIPTION, STOCK_UNIT, CATEGORY_LABEL, ITEM_STATUS_LABEL, STOCK_MANAGEMENT_LABEL, STOCK_ACCEPTED_A, STOCK_QUALITY_Q, STOCK_REJECTED_R, STOCK_TOTAL, ALLOCATED_DETAILED, ALLOCATED_GLOBAL, SHORTAGE_GLOBAL, EXPECTED_SALES_ORDERS, EXPECTED_REPLENISHMENT, IN_TRANSIT, PENDING_ISSUES, STOCK_AVAILABLE, REORDER_POINT, SAFETY_STOCK, STOCK_MAX, BELOW_REORDER_POINT, AVERAGE_COST, STOCK_VALUE_A, LAST_RECEIPT, LAST_ISSUE, LAST_COUNT.","notes":"The figure to quote is STOCK_AVAILABLE (accepted stock minus detailed and global allocations), never STOCK_TOTAL.","max_rows":400,"max_time":30,"sql":"/* Available stock by item and site (ITMMVT totals + ITMFACILIT replenishment parameters). */
SELECT
    ITV.STOFCY_0        AS SITE,
    ITV.ITMREF_0        AS ITEM,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0) AS DESCRIPTION,
    ITM.STU_0           AS STOCK_UNIT,
    ITM.TCLCOD_0        AS CATEGORY_CODE,
    ISNULL(CAT.LABEL, ITM.TCLCOD_0)   AS CATEGORY_LABEL,
    ITM.ITMSTA_0        AS ITEM_STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_STA.LANMES_0, 'Unknown') + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.ITMSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')' AS ITEM_STATUS_LABEL,
    ITM.STOMGTCOD_0     AS STOCK_MANAGEMENT_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_SMG.LANMES_0, 'Unknown') + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.STOMGTCOD_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')' AS STOCK_MANAGEMENT_LABEL,
    ISNULL(ITV.PHYSTO_0, 0)  AS STOCK_ACCEPTED_A,
    ISNULL(ITV.CTLSTO_0, 0)  AS STOCK_QUALITY_Q,
    ISNULL(ITV.REJSTO_0, 0)  AS STOCK_REJECTED_R,
    ISNULL(ITV.PHYSTO_0, 0) + ISNULL(ITV.CTLSTO_0, 0) + ISNULL(ITV.REJSTO_0, 0) AS STOCK_TOTAL,
    ISNULL(ITV.PHYALL_0, 0)  AS ALLOCATED_DETAILED,
    ISNULL(ITV.GLOALL_0, 0)  AS ALLOCATED_GLOBAL,
    ISNULL(ITV.GLOSHT_0, 0)  AS SHORTAGE_GLOBAL,
    ISNULL(ITV.SALSTO_0, 0)  AS EXPECTED_SALES_ORDERS,
    ISNULL(ITV.ORDSTO_0, 0)  AS EXPECTED_REPLENISHMENT,
    ISNULL(ITV.TRFSTO_0, 0)  AS IN_TRANSIT,
    ISNULL(ITV.WAISTO_0, 0)  AS PENDING_ISSUES,
    ISNULL(ITV.PHYSTO_0, 0) - ISNULL(ITV.PHYALL_0, 0) - ISNULL(ITV.GLOALL_0, 0) AS STOCK_AVAILABLE,
    ISNULL(ITF.REOTSD_0, 0)  AS REORDER_POINT,
    ISNULL(ITF.SAFSTO_0, 0)  AS SAFETY_STOCK,
    ISNULL(ITF.MAXSTO_0, 0)  AS STOCK_MAX,
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(ITF.REOTSD_0, 0) > 0
         AND (ISNULL(ITV.PHYSTO_0, 0) - ISNULL(ITV.PHYALL_0, 0) - ISNULL(ITV.GLOALL_0, 0)) < ITF.REOTSD_0
        THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No'
    END                      AS BELOW_REORDER_POINT,
    ITV.AVC_0                AS AVERAGE_COST,
    ISNULL(ITV.PHYSTO_0, 0) * ISNULL(ITV.AVC_0, 0) AS STOCK_VALUE_A,
    NULLIF(ITV.LASRCPDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS LAST_RECEIPT,
    NULLIF(ITV.LASISSDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS LAST_ISSUE,
    NULLIF(ITV.LASCUNDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS LAST_COUNT
FROM ITMMVT ITV

Always bound date_from and date_to.","max_rows":1000,"max_time":60,"sql":"/* Revenue aggregated on the database side, converted to EUR, billed and ordered horizons.
   The level filter picks the GROUPING SETS row family to return. */
SELECT
    AGG.LEVEL               AS LEVEL,
    AGG.REVENUE_TYPE        AS REVENUE_TYPE,
    AGG.YEAR                AS YEAR,
    AGG.MONTH               AS MONTH,
    AGG.CUSTOMER_CODE       AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
    AGG.CUSTOMER_NAME       AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    AGG.ITEM                AS ITEM,
    AGG.DESCRIPTION         AS DESCRIPTION,
    AGG.DOCUMENT_COUNT      AS DOCUMENT_COUNT,
    AGG.LINE_COUNT          AS LINE_COUNT,
    AGG.LINES_WITHOUT_RATE  AS LINES_WITHOUT_RATE,
    AGG.QUANTITY            AS QUANTITY,
    AGG.REVENUE_EUR         AS REVENUE_EUR
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.YEAR) = 0                                     THEN 'Month'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.CUSTOMER_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CA.ITEM) = 0  THEN 'CustomerItem'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.CUSTOMER_CODE) = 0                            THEN 'Customer'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.ITEM) = 0                                     THEN 'Item'
            ELSE 'Total'
        END                                                         AS LEVEL,
        CA.REVENUE_TYPE,
        CA.YEAR,
        CA.MONTH,
        CA.CUSTOMER_CODE,
        CASE WHEN GROUPING(CA.CUSTOMER_CODE) = 0 THEN MAX(CA.CUSTOMER_NAME) END AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
        CA.ITEM,

Always bound date_from and date_to (they apply to the payment date).","max_rows":1000,"max_time":60,"sql":"/* Payment delays on fully settled due dates, customers (receivables) and suppliers (payables),
   aggregated by GROUPING SETS. The level filter picks the row family to return. */
SELECT
    AGG.LEVEL               AS LEVEL,
    AGG.PARTNER_TYPE        AS PARTNER_TYPE,
    AGG.YEAR                AS YEAR,
    AGG.MONTH               AS MONTH,
    AGG.SITE                AS SITE,
    AGG.PARTNER_CODE        AS PARTNER_CODE,
    AGG.PARTNER_NAME        AS PARTNER_NAME,
    AGG.DUE_COUNT           AS DUE_COUNT,
    AGG.AVG_PAYMENT_DAYS    AS AVG_PAYMENT_DAYS,
    AGG.AVG_LATE_DAYS       AS AVG_LATE_DAYS,
    AGG.MAX_LATE_DAYS       AS MAX_LATE_DAYS,
    AGG.LATE_COUNT          AS LATE_COUNT,
    AGG.LATE_PCT            AS LATE_PCT
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.SITE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CA.PARTNER_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CA.YEAR) = 0 THEN 'SitePartnerMonth'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.SITE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CA.PARTNER_CODE) = 0                           THEN 'SitePartner'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.SITE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CA.YEAR) = 0                                   THEN 'SiteMonth'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.PARTNER_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CA.YEAR) = 0                           THEN 'PartnerMonth'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.SITE) = 0                                                             THEN 'Site'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.PARTNER_CODE) = 0                                                     THEN 'Partner'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.YEAR) = 0                                                             THEN 'Month'
            ELSE 'Total'
        END                                                             AS LEVEL,
        CA.PARTNER_TYPE,
        CA.YEAR,
        CA.MONTH,
        CA.SITE,
        CA.PARTNER_CODE,
        CASE WHEN GROUPING(CA.PARTNER_CODE) = 0 THEN MAX(CA.PARTNER_NAME) END AS PARTNER_NAME,
        COUNT(*)                                                        AS DUE_COUNT,
        AVG(CA.PAYMENT_DAYS * 1.0)                                      AS AVG_PAYMENT_DAYS,
        AVG(CA.LATE_DAYS * 1.0)                                         AS AVG_LATE_DAYS,
        MAX(CA.LATE_DAYS)                                               AS MAX_LATE_DAYS,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CA.LATE_DAYS > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)               AS LATE_COUNT,
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN CA.LATE_DAYS > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS LATE_PCT
    FROM (

    /* ---------- Customers ---------- */
    SELECT
        'Customer'                                  AS PARTNER_TYPE,
        D.FCY_0                                     AS SITE,
        D.BPR_0                                     AS PARTNER_CODE,
        BPR.BPRNAM_0                                AS PARTNER_NAME,
        D.NUM_0                                     AS DOCUMENT,
        MAX(H.ACCDAT_0)                             AS PAYMENT_DATE,
        YEAR(MAX(H.ACCDAT_0))                       AS YEAR,
        MONTH(MAX(H.ACCDAT_0))                      AS MONTH,
        DATEDIFF(DAY, I.ACCDAT_0, MAX(H.ACCDAT_0))  AS PAYMENT_DAYS,
        DATEDIFF(DAY, D.DUDDAT_0, MAX(H.ACCDAT_0))  AS LATE_DAYS
    FROM GACCDUDATE D
    INNER JOIN BPCUSTOMER C  ON C.BPCNUM_0 = D.BPR_0
    LEFT  JOIN BPARTNER  BPR ON BPR.BPRNUM_0 = D.BPR_0
    LEFT  JOIN SINVOICE  I   ON I.NUM_0 = D.NUM_0
    INNER JOIN PAYMENTD  P   ON P.VCRNUM_0 = D.NUM_0
    INNER JOIN PAYMENTH  H   ON H.NUM_0 = P.NUM_0
    WHERE (D.AMTCUR_0 - D.PAYCUR_0) = 0
    GROUP BY D.FCY_0, D.BPR_0, BPR.BPRNAM_0, D.NUM_0, D.DUDDAT_0, I.ACCDAT_0

    UNION ALL

    /* ---------- Suppliers ---------- */
    SELECT
        'Supplier',
        D.FCY_0,
        D.BPR_0,
        BPR.BPRNAM_0,
        D.NUM_0,
        MAX(H.ACCDAT_0),
        YEAR(MAX(H.ACCDAT_0)),
        MONTH(MAX(H.ACCDAT_0)),
        DATEDIFF(DAY, I.ACCDAT_0, MAX(H.ACCDAT_0)),
        DATEDIFF(DAY, D.DUDDAT_0, MAX(H.ACCDAT_0))
    FROM GACCDUDATE D
    INNER JOIN BPSUPPLIER S  ON S.BPSNUM_0 = D.BPR_0
    LEFT  JOIN BPARTNER  BPR ON BPR.BPRNUM_0 = D.BPR_0
    LEFT  JOIN PINVOICE  I   ON I.NUM_0 = D.NUM_0
    INNER JOIN PAYMENTD  P   ON P.VCRNUM_0 = D.NUM_0
    INNER JOIN PAYMENTH  H   ON H.NUM_0 = P.NUM_0
    WHERE (D.AMTCUR_0 - D.PAYCUR_0) = 0
    GROUP BY D.FCY_0, D.BPR_0, BPR.BPRNAM_0, D.NUM_0, D.DUDDAT_0, I.ACCDAT_0

    ) CA
    WHERE 1 = 1
    /*FILTERS*/
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (CA.PARTNER_TYPE),
        (CA.PARTNER_TYPE, CA.SITE),
        (CA.PARTNER_TYPE, CA.PARTNER_CODE),
        (CA.PARTNER_TYPE, CA.YEAR, CA.MONTH),
        (CA.PARTNER_TYPE, CA.SITE, CA.PARTNER_CODE),
        (CA.PARTNER_TYPE, CA.SITE, CA.YEAR, CA.MONTH),
        (CA.PARTNER_TYPE, CA.PARTNER_CODE, CA.YEAR, CA.MONTH),
        (CA.PARTNER_TYPE, CA.SITE, CA.PARTNER_CODE, CA.YEAR, CA.MONTH)
    )
) AGG
WHERE 1 = 1
/*FILTERS:level*/

Module numbers: 1 Supervisor, 2 Financials, 3 A/P-A/R accounting, 5 Sales, 6 Purchasing, 7 Stock, 8 Manufacturing, 9 Common data, 11 Sage X3 internal, 13 CRM, 14 Fixed assets.","max_rows":300,"max_time":30,"sql":"/* Sage X3 object dictionary (AOBJET) with labels, module, main table, main screen, primary key

SELECT

// Code node "Shape the object response" of the X3 Object Runner (run once for all items).
// Receives the Validate item (errors, routed straight here) or the envelope of a Sage X3 node.

function shape() {
  const meta = $('Validate the object call').first().json;
  const item = $input.first() ? $input.first().json : {};
  if (meta && meta.ok === false) return meta;

  const out = { ok: true, action: meta.action, object: meta.object, transaction: meta.transaction || '', identifier: meta.identifier || '' };

  if (item && item.error !== undefined && item.success === undefined) {
    return Object.assign(out, { ok: false, error: 'transport_error', message: typeof item.error === 'string' ? item.error : JSON.stringify(item.error), http_status: item.httpStatus });
  }
  const messages = Array.isArray(item.messages) ? item.messages.filter((m) => m && typeof m === 'object' ? Object.keys(m).some((k) => k !== 'trace') : !!m) : [];
  if (item.success === false) {
    const text = messages.map((m) => (typeof m === 'string' ? m : m.error || m.message || JSON.stringify(m))).join(' | ');
    return Object.assign(out, { ok: false, error: 'x3_error', message: text || 'Sage X3 refused the call', trace: item.trace, hint: 'Read the message: wrong identifier, guessed field name, missing mandatory field or business rule. Fix the call before retrying; never retry a write without asking.' });
